ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR50] Requires Free Storage Period while in Negotiation only, for RIM/MAS/ALM Business Unit deals billing to the listed countries. Simplified per IRM feedback.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity',
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ),
AND( OR( RIM_BU__c = TRUE, MAS_BU__c = TRUE, ALM_BU__c = TRUE ), OR( QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'United States', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Canada', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Ireland', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'France', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Belgium', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Netherlands', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Sweden', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Denmark' ) ),
ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'),
ISPICKVAL(Free_Storage_Period__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Free Storage Period is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a value.
